MeasureTheory.dLpNorm.statement: Let $\alpha$ be a measurable space and $E$ a normed additive commutative group. For an extended nonnegative real $p\in[0,\infty]$ and a function $f:\alpha\to E$, $\mathrm{dLpNorm}(p,f)\in\mathbb{R}$ is defined to be $\mathrm{lpNorm}(f,p,\mathrm{count})$, the real-valued $L^p$ norm of $f$ with respect to the counting measure $\mathrm{count}$ on $\alpha$ (so for $0<p<\infty$ and $\alpha$ with measurable singletons this is $\big(\sum_{a\in\alpha}\|f(a)\|^p\big)^{1/p}$ when finite). According to its docstring, this is the $L^p$ norm of a function with the compact normalisation.
